correctness.rationale: For the specified right null-filiform algebra, applying the derivation identity to the basis recurrence determines D uniquely by D(e1) and gives D=uH+f(N). For u=0, f(N)=N^d h(N) with h(0) nonzero has ker f(N)^j=ker N^(dj), determining P(n,d). For u nonzero, [H,N^j]=j N^j and conjugation by the unit g(N) eliminates precisely non-p-divisible degrees via invertible uj; its coefficient recursion is a bijection, not just an existence argument. The retained polynomial in N^p preserves p-residue classes with eigenvalues cu and partitions P(m_c,r), and the first nonzero coefficient gives exact q-counts. Nullity m=floor(n/p) on the zero-eigenvalue class yields the rank formula and invertibility iff p>n. Verified independent direct GF2, n=5 enumeration of 32 matrices against predicted eight conditional profiles and nullity counts. No finite test establishes the all-n result.
